metric_notes: All-attempt totals include unique retry tokens once; final-task totals retain only the last archived task result.
Compute CPU is cpu_seconds. Total CPU is total_cpu_seconds; failed attempts without that field use explicitly counted sampled_cpu_seconds. Missing measurements are not inferred.
Task overlap measures lease/attempt intervals including publication, not simultaneous CPU execution. Mean CPUs divide measured CPU seconds by earliest-start/latest-finish task span.
Peak process-lifetime RSS may include earlier work in a persistent process. Unsampled tasks do not establish zero task memory.
Cache calls, hits and dependency checks are explicit per-task deltas in ReactionCache.proposal; I/O is per task. Retained bytes and entry counts are snapshot maxima, never summed.
Recovered reactions require either direction. Otherwise error, missing, unknown and two proven not-recovered directions remain distinct.

matching.allocation_envelope_definition: First matching allocation start through last matching allocation finish, including staggered starts; excludes pre-start queue wait.

all_outputs_cpu_accounting.note: Sum of 3701 new v4 decoding tasks and the one earlier reused point task; this is not one fresh uninterrupted pass.

decoding_v4.allocation_envelope_definition: First v4 decoding allocation start through last allocation finish, including queue gaps; excludes the earlier reused point task, preparation and integrity audit.

limits: The prior end-to-end elapsed timeline includes decoder failure, investigation, a retry, independent verification and later decoder replacement. No clean comparable full-pipeline baseline wall time is asserted.

The new first array combines matching and deduplication. Its allocation wall time must not be compared directly with the baseline matching-only 373 seconds; separate stage spans or CPU accounting are needed.
Baseline v4 decoder wall time covers only3701 freshly decoded directions; one completed point output is reused. Combined CPU accounting includes its earlier task explicitly.
Reference policy is Golden complete heavy-atom relation including unmatched atoms modulo chemical endpoint symmetry; it is not EnzymeMap exact-index verification.
Baseline config includes the historical growth_policy=existence selector removed by current code. All remaining scientific settings must remain identical in rerun indexes.
Baseline matching used100 active workers per pool but averaged16.7–22.0 worker CPU cores over task spans. Worker concurrency is not CPU saturation.

Deduplication and verification CPU totals are archived per-task audit aggregates from the original campaign; the verification includes the independent allocation used for the decoder-blocked batch. Original decoder failure metrics are not used as the current decoder baseline.
Task CPU aggregates use recorded total_cpu_seconds when present, otherwise sampled_cpu_seconds. Compare the new audit with the same aggregation convention, and retain compute-only totals separately.
Wall time and sampled RSS remain subject to node placement, workload, scheduler/storage effects and sampling coverage; algorithmic speedup is not isolated by cross-run wall time alone.
